facts.text_zh: 黑方的王被將軍後移動，失去易位權；另一條變化裡已經易位

shown: Blunder. Rxe4 misses dxe5, which wins a rook for a pawn (22.dxe5).
Mistake. f6 allows 19.Qxc7, threatening mate on d8. Bd7 was the move.
Blunder. Na3 misses Qa4+, which wins a knight (6.Qa4+ Nc6 7.Ne5 e6 8.Nxc6).
